name: Timberline Cylinder Stove by Colorado Cylinder Stoves
description: Timberline Cylinder Stove by Colorado Cylinder Made in America! Colorado Cylinder Stoves are handcrafted in Western Colorado. This stove is constructed of heavy 10 and 12 gauge steel so it will hold heat longer, last longer, and keep you warm when its freezing outside. Whether youre using it in a small cabin* or a tiny home*, this stove will make it feel like home sweet home. Benefit Features of Timberline Cylinder Stove No warping! Your stove top is reinforced with 1x1 angle iron so it wont warp while burning high heat fuel such as coal. The door is also reinforced and the cylinder shape of the stove body will naturally keep it from distorting. More Radiant Heat Because your stove is made of heavy-duty steel, it will hold onto heat longer and provide more radiant heat, unlike lighter gauge sheet metal stoves. This will allow you to heat a larger area and will perform better with colder temperatures. Cook Top The top of your stove is designed so you have room for a pot or skillet so you can cook a nice hot meal while youre in the great outdoors. Hot Water Hot water is an essential amenity while camping for washing up or hot coffee! The stainless steel hot water tank is welded water tight and includes a lead-free brass water faucet. This means your water is potable and you dont have to worry about lead contaminating your water. We have designed the water tank for strength and safety so there are no sharp edges, no leaks, and built to last. Compact - All of the accessories including the water tank fit inside the stove for easy storage and transportation.
